title: Store bidirectional relationships in issue model
description: Add new RelationType variants: HasPart (inverse of part_of), Requires (inverse of required_for), ScheduledAfter (inverse of scheduled_before). Modify Issue.relationships to support reverse relationships. Update relationship storage logic to maintain both directions automatically. Plan migration path for existing .pebbles directories. Update SPEC.md. After this, update display logic from relationship UX pebble to use direct references instead of searching all issues.
